title: Laravel Webpack Instantsearchjs 2.6.* Reference Errors
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js, I could not find what I was looking for which is: 
We ware using Instandsearch.js with Laravel and Webpack.
We made an update via npm to instantsearch.js 2.6.*.
If we restart our Laravel Application we get Reference Errors in our JavaScript Files for Example:
ReferenceError: $ is not defined in some other JS-Files.
If we open the Page with the instandsearch we get also this Error:
TypeError: window.instantsearch is not a function

If we downgrade to Version Instantsearch.js 2.0.2 everything is working fine.
Thats really strange and we have no idea what we can do that version 2.6. is working without these Errors in our other JS-Files.

comments.body: Hi @devprojectsapps. Thanks for taking the time to fill in this issue. Can you give an URL where we could see the behaviour? If your app is private, you can go through the Algolia support.

It is so strange. In our package.json i changed "instantsearch.js": "2.0.2" to "instantsearch.js": "^2.0.2". Then i made npm update. In our app.js we have:
`window.$ = require('jquery');
window.instantsearch = require('instantsearch.js');`

If i start the app we ware getting Reference Errors like "ReferenceError: $ is not defined" to this line "$(function()" in a different JS File.

If i got back to instantsearch.js 2.0.2 everything is working fine without any Reference Errors.

Thats soooo strange :-(
It would help if you could at least provide us the steps to follow to reproduce your environment.
